callouts.label: Read the Label
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents read the label.
callouts.description: Read the medicine label and directions with a trusted adult when appropriate.
callouts.ap_tip: Check warnings and active ingredients. Ask a pharmacist about anything unclear.

callouts.label: Correct Person
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents correct person.
callouts.description: Use only medicine intended for the named person.
callouts.ap_tip: Bodies and conditions differ. Never use someone else’s prescription.

callouts.label: Correct Timing
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents correct timing.
callouts.description: Follow the prescribed or labeled schedule.
callouts.ap_tip: Do not double a missed dose unless a professional directs it. Use a safe reminder system.

callouts.label: Check Allergies and Interactions
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents check allergies and interactions.
callouts.description: Medicines can interact with allergies, other drugs, supplements, alcohol, or health conditions.
callouts.ap_tip: Share an accurate list with the pharmacist or clinician. Seek help for unexpected reactions.

callouts.label: Ask a Professional
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents ask a professional.
callouts.description: Pharmacists and clinicians can explain purpose, use, storage, and side effects.
callouts.ap_tip: Bring questions before starting or stopping medicine. Do not change a prescription on your own.

callouts.label: Secure Storage
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents secure storage.
callouts.description: Store medicine away from children, pets, and people for whom it was not prescribed.
callouts.ap_tip: Use locked storage when risk requires it. Follow temperature and moisture directions.

callouts.label: Original Container
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents original container.
callouts.description: Keep medicine in its original labeled container unless a professional-approved organizer is used.
callouts.ap_tip: The label helps identify the medicine and instructions. Avoid loose, unidentified pills.

callouts.label: Do Not Share
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents do not share.
callouts.description: Do not offer or accept prescription medicine.
callouts.ap_tip: Sharing can cause harm and may be illegal. Support a friend by connecting them with care.

callouts.label: Safe Disposal
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents safe disposal.
callouts.description: Use a take-back location or local disposal guidance for unused medicine.
callouts.ap_tip: Do not flush medicine unless official instructions specifically say to. Remove personal information from discarded packaging.

callouts.label: Poison or Emergency Help
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents poison or emergency help.
callouts.description: Call poison control or emergency services for a suspected overdose, severe reaction, or dangerous mistake.
callouts.ap_tip: Do not wait for symptoms when advised to call. Bring the container or label information when safe.
